plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Emerson NetSure / EES DC power systems (NETSURE-MIB-004-A, enterprise PEN 6302). It reports uptime, power system alarm status, system voltage and current, battery voltage and capacity, temperature, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: system_state
metrics.description: Highest active alarm level of the Emerson NetSure power system from systemStatus (NETSURE-MIB-004-A, 1.3.6.1.4.1.6302.2.1.2.1.0): normal maps to 1; warning, minor, major and critical map to 2. unknown, unmanaged, restricted, testing and disabled produce no value.

metrics.name: system_voltage_volts
metrics.description: DC system voltage in volts, from systemVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.6302.2.1.2.2.0, mV, divided by 1000). The sign reported by the controller is kept (negative on -48 V plants); the invalid marker 2147483647 and 0 are dropped.

metrics.name: system_current_amps
metrics.description: Total DC system (load) current in amperes, from systemCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.6302.2.1.2.3.0, mA, divided by 1000). The invalid marker 2147483647 is dropped.

metrics.name: battery_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Battery voltage in volts, from psBatteryVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.6302.2.1.2.5.1.0, mV, divided by 1000). The invalid marker 2147483647 and 0 are dropped.

metrics.name: battery_capacity_percent
metrics.description: Calculated remaining battery capacity in percent of total capacity, from psBatteryCapacity (1.3.6.1.4.1.6302.2.1.2.5.3.0). The invalid marker 2147483647 is dropped.

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of the first and second temperature routes in degrees Celsius, from psTemperature1 / psTemperature2 (1.3.6.1.4.1.6302.2.1.2.7.1.0 / .7.2.0, 0.001 degree units, divided by 1000). Unconnected routes (2147483647) are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
